tested_scope: GitHub REST repository-contents API used only as lightweight scheduled-Chat state/evidence transport with cross-invocation checkpoint/resume; not hosted compute, not a complete richer-mode parity route.

primary_sources.claim_checked: The repository-contents API provides get-content and create-or-update-file operations; mutative contents operations should be serialized rather than run concurrently.
GitHub REST requests are rate-limited in time windows; authenticated requests have a primary per-hour request limit, so transport cannot assume unlimited same-run API access.
GitHub recommends serial requests and stopping/retrying later after rate-limit responses; this is compatible with cross-invocation checkpoint/resume and incompatible with same-run spin/retry.

findings.reason_complete_route_not_verified: This slice verifies only durable repository transport and rate-limit-aware recurrence behavior. It does not prove that every material richer-mode outcome can be produced without another executor.

continuation: Next invocation: verify one exact proposed Chat-native execution mechanism above the transport layer against its primary source and exposed-tool evidence, preferring a route that claims to replace an actual richer-mode effect rather than merely persist state.
